prompt:

Use references only for Accu’s canon identity, teal/violet/black kit, scale and pixel-art shading; redraw new poses. Accu is a stylish young adult human woman with warm tan skin, vivid green eyes, blunt black bangs, close-cropped sides, and two long black twin ponytails with teal ties. Keep her human anatomy and sleek teal/violet/black uniform consistent. Each cell has one complete body, clear hands/shoes/ponytails, same scale and baseline. No labels, borders, scenery, floor, shadows, hoop, ball or props. Hands are EMPTY; the game draws the basketball separately. Crisp 1990s arcade pixel clusters, sharp outlines, alpha-zero gutters/background.

This is a deliberate overhead pass (not a shot). Frame order: 0 balanced stance with hands chest-high; 1 knees flex as hands lift above forehead; 2 step forward and cock hands overhead; 3 RELEASE at tick7 with both arms reaching up and toward image-right, wrists flicked, palms open and empty; 4 upward follow-through with weight forward; 5 stable recovery with arms lowered. All six drawings are distinct and connected. Return only the sprite sheet.
ballPolicy: Separate Accu-specific ball rises with her overhead hands and releases at frame3/tick7; it is never painted into the poses.
